integrity.computation_role: Exhaustive certificate for the finite nine-point instance; the verifier also performs an independent reverse-direction enumeration and checks every generated map against the full transitive order.
integrity.originality_risk: The same nine-point poset appears in Rival's 1976 fixed-point paper; accessible material did not show the present self-homotopy census, but the unavailable full text leaves a specific residual risk.
integrity.proof_basis: Stong's comparable-map homotopy criterion plus exhaustive finite enumeration of all isotone self-maps and exact pointwise-comparability components.

scientific_limitations: Exact only for the Cianci--Ottina nine-point model and its opposite; no classification is claimed for ten-point or larger weakly contractible non-contractible spaces.
No beat-point core or higher homotopy type is asserted for the large component of the self-mapping space.
Rival's 1976 full text was not materially available for complete originality comparison, and this is retained as a residual literature risk.
title: Three self-homotopy classes on the minimal nine-point weakly contractible finite space
